records.title: Fundamentals of Environmental Sustainability
records.header: TEST 200 Fundamentals of Environmental Sustainability (5) SSc
records.text: TEST 200 Fundamentals of Environmental Sustainability (5) SSc Investigates knowledge from humanities, social sciences, and natural sciences, to prepare students for advanced coursework in environmental studies. Applies insights to actual environmental problems and situations at scales from local to global. Serves as the required core course for the Environmental Sustainability major. Each environmental problem is examined through the lens of ethics, institutions, economics, power, and science. Course overlaps with: BIS 246.

records.title: A Natural History of Garbage
records.header: TEST 332 A Natural History of Garbage (5) SSc/NSc
records.text: TEST 332 A Natural History of Garbage (5) SSc/NSc Examines past and present practices of disposing of civilization's detritus. Uses methods of historical inquiry and environmental studies to get at the roots of one of the fundamental issues confronting the industrialized world: the disposal of waste. Research-based and includes field work.

records.title: Natural Resources Policy: America's Public Forests and Parks
records.header: TEST 337 Natural Resources Policy: America's Public Forests and Parks (5) SSc
records.text: TEST 337 Natural Resources Policy: America's Public Forests and Parks (5) SSc Explores fundamental and applied concepts in United States public forest and lands policy. Emphasizes political, legal, and administrative issues of federal and state lands, especially forests.

records.title: Investing in the Environment
records.header: TEST 345 Investing in the Environment (5) SSc
records.text: TEST 345 Investing in the Environment (5) SSc Reviews comprehensively the substantive elements of current and developing global environmental markets in carbon, water quantity and quality, biodiversity, clean energy, and fisheries. Discusses current issues in environmental markets.

records.text: TEST 495 Environmental Studies Experience (3) NSc Introduces students to project design and outreach that incorporates a combination of service learning and research. May include field work or community engagement or outreach on a variety of topics, depending on instructor.
